notes: THE KEY FILE OF THIS BATCH - it contains TWO position panels and resolves the ambiguities left by IMG_7801 and IMG_7804. Panel 1 (16/03/2026, beside the 07:09 message): LINK/USD Long, NET VALUE $252,432.51, PnL +$79,141.40 (+45.52%), ENTRY $8.7933, MARK $9.6227, LIQUIDATION $7.3229. The clean '+$79.141.40' here CONFIRMS the reading I refused to guess in IMG_7804 (OCR'd there as '+579.141.40'), so pnl.value is now populated. Panel 2 (17/03/2026): 'LINKUSD 6.55x Long', SAME ENTRY $8.7933, MARK $9.9651, LIQUIDATION $7.4990. RECONCILIATION: net 252,432.51 - gain 79,141.40 = collateral 173,291.11, matching IMG_7804's $172,898.81 to within fees/funding; gain is 45.67% of that vs the stated 45.52%. Size $1,000,814.99 / collateral 173,291.11 = 5.78x, which strongly implies the '5.79%' (IMG_7804) and '5.7%' (here) beside 'LINK/USD ... Long' are actually LEVERAGE ('5.7x'), the same field that reads '6.55x' on 17/03 - so he ADDED to the position between 16 and 17 March while the entry price stayed $8.7933. pnl.leverage records the explicit '6.55x'; the 5.7x is inferred and left in this note only. pnl.size is left NULL because $1,000,814.99 sits ambiguously between the 'SIZE' label and an 'Orders (1)' row and appears identically in both panels; note also that entry->mark of +9.43% against +45.52% on collateral implies ~4.83x effective, not 5.78x, so the size figure does not fully reconcile and should not be trusted as position size. TRADE TIMELINE FOR BACKTESTING: LINK long from $8.7933; $9.6227 on 16/03 07:09 (+9.4% on price); $9.9651 on 17/03 (+13.3% on price); he calls 'start taking profit' at 17/03 11:36 and at 15:23 still says 'I don't feel we topped yet' - a scale-out, not a full exit, so the closing price is NOT in this image.
